evals.prompt: Resume the previous audit after a disconnect and tell me what is verified versus blocked.
evals.expected_output: Should re-anchor repo/branch/host, inspect current local evidence before trusting memory, separate validated locally, verified live, pushed/deployed, and blocked/not verified states, and continue from the first unblocked next step.
assertions: Inspects local evidence before trusting memory
Separates local live deployed and blocked states

evals.prompt: Old Codex thread will not load and the previous cwd is under Documents with weird Git hangs.
evals.expected_output: Should treat stale cwd and iCloud/File Provider placeholder symptoms as workspace-health blockers, run bounded Git and key-file probes, avoid concluding project work is missing, and recommend hydration or a non-iCloud working copy before editing.
assertions: Recognizes stale cwd and File Provider risk
Runs bounded Git or key-file health probes
Does not conclude project work is missing from memory alone
Recommends hydration or non-iCloud working copy before edits

evals.prompt: Pick up from the deployment thread, but the remaining work is account auth and browser QA.
evals.expected_output: Should preserve completed local/deploy evidence, mark auth/browser QA as blocked or manual, open or identify the target when feasible, and provide concrete ordered steps.
assertions: Marks account auth or browser QA blocker
Does not keep coding around an external blocker
